new_value: No bug exists. The infinite loop scenario is impossible due to HashMap semantics: (1) max_peers uses NonZeroUsize ensuring capacity >= 1, (2) min_by_key() on a non-empty map always returns Some, (3) the key from iteration is guaranteed to exist in the map for the subsequent remove() call since this is &mut self with no concurrent modification. The existing break on oldest.is_none() handles the only valid empty-map case. Tests at lines 2050, 2075, 2112, and 2149 verify eviction works correctly under various conditions including counter saturation.
